description: SEC 13F institutional holdings — Latest (or earlier) Form 13F-HR holdings of an institutional investment manager from SEC EDGAR: total reported value, positions aggregated by CUSIP, top holdings with portfolio weights, top-10 concentration, puts/calls, and quarter-over-quarter changes (new, added, reduced, exited positions) vs the prior report. cik= required (e.g. 1067983 Berkshire Hathaway). Optional: filing=0-7 (0 = latest), limit=5-100 top holdings (default 25), compare=false to skip the prior-quarter diff. Information tables over 4 MB (the very largest managers) are not supported. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
